links.comparator_used: Binary agitation identification from the LightGBM model at a single threshold, without traffic-light stratification
links.outcome: Specificity and other performance metrics for identifying agitation over an 8-day period
links.effect: Specificity rose from 75.28% ± 7.38 (LightGBM without stratification) to 90.3% ± 7.55 with the traffic-light system; all metrics improved
links.quote: Implementing the traffic-light system for stratification increased specificity to 90.3% ± 7.55 and improved all metrics.
